ModMetaData.name: CE AutoFire Tracking
ModMetaData.author: lemonade
ModMetaData.description: Makes Combat Extended's Auto Fire mode track moving targets shot by shot instead of locking aim after the first shot. In vanilla CE, every shot after the first in a burst reuses the opening trajectory, if the target sidesteps, the rest of the burst lands where they were. This mod re-aims each shot while the fire-mode selector is set to Auto Fire, so sustained fire follows a moving target. Single Fire and Burst Fire are unchanged. Requires Combat Extended.
